description: Maharashtra and Tata Group’s $11 billion AI Innovation City near Navi Mumbai Airport will feature data centres, semiconductors and GCCs. The 300-acre project aims to boost India’s digital infrastructure, with 66% of national data-centre capacity already in the state. The initiative aligns with Maharashtra’s broader AI agenda, including six Centres of Excellence and new universities to fuel tech growth.
body_lead: Maharashtra govt moves to fast-track AI Innovation City with Tata Group The Maharashtra Government and the Tata Group had announced a landmark $ 11 billion investment to build India’s first Innovation City . AI-generated representative image.
